purpose: <what this communication is for -- meeting invite, result notice, cooperation request, reminder, periodic update>
student_name_or_placeholder: <full student name -- REQUIRED filled-in if recipient_scope is single_student, leave empty string if recipient_scope is whole_class>
body_sections: <content point 1 -- the actual information being conveyed>
requested_action: <what, if anything, the parent needs to do -- can be an empty string for a pure FYI message>
sender_name: <full name of the sender -- teacher or school representative>
sender_title: <e.g. Giao vien chu nhiem, TM. Ban Giam hieu>
contact_info: <phone/email for the parent to reply to -- leave empty string if genuinely unavailable, do NOT invent one>
